hyperedges.label: Three attractor families form the tier ladder with its validity inversion
Closed-form prediction pipeline: order rule to branch rule to LP-verified point prediction at the mode ceiling
Preregistered extensions M/MU/CH each narrowed the claim's scope via a triggered falsifier or decomposition
Registered echo bound: registration -> fresh seeds -> must-differ -> scheme control
Blindness cascade: viability/validity, then echo, then accepted steps, then final best score
Self-audit withdrawals: canary fires on fixed path, repair fails three ways

nodes.label: Template Anchoring in Unconditioned Zero-Shot Circle Packing (Rev 2)
nodes.author: Soham Shailesh Gugale
nodes.norm_label: template anchoring in unconditioned zero-shot circle packing (rev 2)

nodes.label: Circle packing benchmark (max sum of radii, N circles, unit square)
nodes.rationale: Chosen because feasibility is decidable exactly from emitted coordinates, so proposals score with no human in the loop; benchmark choice described as strategic rather than novel.
nodes.norm_label: circle packing benchmark (max sum of radii, n circles, unit square)

nodes.label: Unconditioned proposal (zero-shot, no parent, no feedback, generation 0)
nodes.rationale: Framed as the limiting case that in-loop seeded initializations approach as seed information goes to zero; a source audit found no in-loop call in cited systems that is unconditioned.
nodes.norm_label: unconditioned proposal (zero-shot, no parent, no feedback, generation 0)

nodes.label: Code-free prompt design
nodes.rationale: A code channel would route the task to a numerical optimizer, so the distribution would reflect the optimizer; the reason is asserted, not measured — no code-enabled arm was run.

nodes.label: Order rule k*(N) = round(sqrt(N))
nodes.rationale: Declared a definition, not a hypothesis: two formalizations of 'nearest' coincide on the integers, and candidate scoring (nearest 3/3 vs floor/argmax 2/3) is weakly identified under a coin-flip null.

nodes.label: Anchor (template the distribution concentrates on at a given N)
nodes.norm_label: anchor (template the distribution concentrates on at a given n)

nodes.label: Branch rule (the falsifiable content)
nodes.rationale: Isolated as the hypothesis because nothing about 'nearest' forces truncation — truncate-versus-drop-and-fill is a genuine dichotomy, unlike the order rule.

nodes.label: Extend branch (k*^2 <= N): fill with m = N - k*^2 fillers
nodes.rationale: Disconfirmed at m >= 4 by arm M; restricted to the m <= 1 support previously observed.
nodes.norm_label: extend branch (k*^2 <= n): fill with m = n - k*^2 fillers

nodes.label: Trap zones N in [k^2-k+1, k^2-1]
nodes.rationale: A property of the branch behavior, not of the packing problem; branch label and penalty are not coextensive (4 of 22 trap-branch N cost nothing).

nodes.label: Independent linear-programming value oracle
nodes.rationale: Value claims are gated on an oracle that knows nothing about the recipe, so the closed form under test is never its own checker; 83 square + 213 rectangle configurations to within 1e-9.

nodes.label: Mode ceiling result (formula sits at the modal frequency)
nodes.rationale: Reframes the fair objection that a sub-100% per-sample hit rate is not 'predicting the exact output': no predictor of a single value can exceed the modal frequency, and this one attains it at 7 of 7 cells.
nodes.norm_label: mode ceiling result (formula sits at the modal frequency)

nodes.label: Discriminating cells (rule disagrees with family optimum)
nodes.norm_label: discriminating cells (rule disagrees with family optimum)

nodes.label: Preregistration protocol (prompt hashes, point predictions, falsifiers)
nodes.rationale: Adopted as a standard rather than claimed as a contribution; the twist is what is locked — exact-output point predictions from a closed form on a held-out container.
nodes.norm_label: preregistration protocol (prompt hashes, point predictions, falsifiers)

nodes.label: Prompt-fragment hash limitation
nodes.rationale: Disclosed rather than repaired: the subagent inherits instruction files outside the task prompt, so digests lock only a fragment of the conditioning context; N=43 and the pilot prompt have no registered hash at all.

nodes.label: Dual validity tolerances 1e-6 (primary) and 1e-9
nodes.rationale: Proposers print six to eight decimals so an eight-decimal tangency misses contact by ~5e-9, while 1e-6 sits far below the ~1e-2 gap between rival constructions.

nodes.label: 2e-3 value-matching window (and its defect)
nodes.rationale: Chosen for the anchor comparison where the nearest competing value is ~0.15 away, then reused where it does not fit — it swallowed a 1.47e-3 out-of-family escape at N=31; categorical claims are therefore made at structure level or 1e-6.

nodes.label: Arm F — bare weak-tier square arm
nodes.norm_label: arm f — bare weak-tier square arm

nodes.label: Arm M — preregistered extension (N = 20, 30, 41, 57)
nodes.rationale: Run after external review to close two named gaps: V(k,m)'s filler branch was supported only at m in {0,1}, and the k=8 trap zone appeared in Figure 1 but was never sampled.

nodes.label: Arm MU — one-parent mutation arm
nodes.rationale: Registered to test whether the unconditioned result transfers to the parent-conditioned regime discovery loops actually run in; falsifier F-MU1 and its consequence were written down before the first invocation.

nodes.label: Arm CH — recipe-family choice probe
nodes.rationale: Designed as the separating experiment for the arithmetic-tractability alternative: enumerate the whole family including the argmax so computation burden is removed, then see what the model chooses.

nodes.label: Arm GM2 — cross-vendor null-compliance (0/140 parseable)
nodes.rationale: All cells UNSCOREABLE per the registered rule; a 0/140 parse rate at a 4,096-token cap is also the signature of budget truncation, so cause is deferred to arm GM3.

nodes.label: Three-tier validity ladder (78% -> 100% -> 13%)
nodes.rationale: Reported both ways (with and without opus_alias) and with a matched-cell row (83% -> 100% -> 13%) because tier denominators are not matched — the weak tier spans seven N against three.

nodes.label: Middle tier (Sonnet) — perturbs and mixes radii
nodes.norm_label: middle tier (sonnet) — perturbs and mixes radii

nodes.label: Top tier (opus_alias) — recursive gaskets, fails to build them
nodes.norm_label: top tier (opus_alias) — recursive gaskets, fails to build them

nodes.label: Ambition-validity inversion
nodes.rationale: 'Monotone' applies to one axis only: ambition rises monotonically while validity rises then collapses — stated explicitly to correct revision 1's framing.

nodes.label: opus_alias provenance caveat (alias-to-weights binding not attestable)
nodes.rationale: The runtime accepts only a bare alias and exposes no dated identifier, so the binding is a vendor promise; latency and token anomalies live only in an unreleased session transcript and are treated as anecdotal.
nodes.norm_label: opus_alias provenance caveat (alias-to-weights binding not attestable)

nodes.label: P-M1-P-M3 — filler branch at m >= 4 (DISCONFIRMED, 3 of 3 cells)
nodes.norm_label: p-m1-p-m3 — filler branch at m >= 4 (disconfirmed, 3 of 3 cells)

nodes.label: Emergent rectangle-factorization regularity (N = a x b near sqrt N)
nodes.rationale: The replacement regularity is arithmetic rather than geometric — rectangle factorization is mentally computable where filler tangency is not, which is further evidence for the tractability alternative.
nodes.norm_label: emergent rectangle-factorization regularity (n = a x b near sqrt n)

nodes.label: P-M4 — N = 57 truncation T(8,57) = 3.5625000 (CONFIRMED, fifth k)
nodes.norm_label: p-m4 — n = 57 truncation t(8,57) = 3.5625000 (confirmed, fifth k)

nodes.label: F-MU1 — anchoring dissolves under in-family-rival parent (TRIGGERED, 0/26)
nodes.norm_label: f-mu1 — anchoring dissolves under in-family-rival parent (triggered, 0/26)

nodes.label: P-MU4 — off-family parent snap-back to template (58.8%, holds at 2/3 cells)
nodes.norm_label: p-mu4 — off-family parent snap-back to template (58.8%, holds at 2/3 cells)

nodes.label: P-CH1 — template survives argmax enumeration (holds 2 of 3 cells, as registered)
nodes.norm_label: p-ch1 — template survives argmax enumeration (holds 2 of 3 cells, as registered)

nodes.label: P-CH2 — model switches to stated argmax (disconfirmed at 1 of 3 cells)
nodes.norm_label: p-ch2 — model switches to stated argmax (disconfirmed at 1 of 3 cells)

nodes.label: CH survivorship artifact (registered scorer conditions on execution success)
nodes.rationale: Disclosed rather than exploited: all 31 invalid rows attempt the stated argmax, so the valid-conditioned modal is dominated by the template precisely because the template is the only thing the model executes reliably.
nodes.norm_label: ch survivorship artifact (registered scorer conditions on execution success)

nodes.label: Choice-versus-execution decomposition (the template is what the model can build)
nodes.norm_label: choice-versus-execution decomposition (the template is what the model can build)

nodes.label: P-T1 — trace raises validity (NOT confirmed, p = 0.30)
nodes.norm_label: p-t1 — trace raises validity (not confirmed, p = 0.30)

nodes.label: P-T3 — anchor concentration 87% vs 70% (met, inferentially fragile)
nodes.norm_label: p-t3 — anchor concentration 87% vs 70% (met, inferentially fragile)

nodes.label: Trace elicitation as intervention, not observation
nodes.rationale: Requesting a process descriptor perturbs the distribution being measured, so descriptor-driven quality-diversity pipelines should treat this as a reason to check, not a coefficient to apply.
nodes.norm_label: trace elicitation as intervention, not observation

nodes.label: trace_v2 bundling confound (method line + output-line rewording)
nodes.rationale: Disclosed and held to the same standard that got the pilot discarded: the output-line rewording does measurable work on parse compliance, so the measured effect is method-line-plus-rewording.
nodes.norm_label: trace_v2 bundling confound (method line + output-line rewording)

nodes.label: Faithfulness audit with ground truth (claim vs emitted coordinates)
nodes.rationale: Verifies description against the artifact, not the process; confounded with the elicitation arm, where 87% of outputs sit on one template and correct description is close to free.
nodes.norm_label: faithfulness audit with ground truth (claim vs emitted coordinates)

nodes.label: Blind rescore under git-frozen rubric (commit e181d2a)
nodes.rationale: Rubric committed before any rescoring run so the freeze is checkable, and it pre-committed the reporting rule (below 90% = not confirmed, no consolation framing).
nodes.norm_label: blind rescore under git-frozen rubric (commit e181d2a)

nodes.label: Collection-wave confound in the bare arm
nodes.norm_label: collection-wave confound in the bare arm

nodes.label: Operationalization drift between preregistration text and analysis code
nodes.rationale: Named as a failure mode because registered prose leaves tie handling and bound inclusivity implicit; remedies (register the comparison as executable code, or state the tie convention) are free before sampling and impossible afterward.
nodes.norm_label: operationalization drift between preregistration text and analysis code

nodes.label: Rectangle rule q* = round(sqrt(N/a)), p* = round(sqrt(N*a))
nodes.rationale: The same rule with aspect ratio put back, restated but never refitted, and written before any rectangle model output existed.
nodes.norm_label: rectangle rule q* = round(sqrt(n/a)), p* = round(sqrt(n*a))

nodes.label: Rectangle outcome: 5/11 on-prediction, 0/11 rival (partial support)
nodes.rationale: Reported as partial support, not confirmation: a proposer choosing uniformly among ~3 plausible template shapes lands on-prediction about a third of the time, so 5/11 does not separate from that null.

nodes.label: Negative result: closed form does not survive the move to rectangles
nodes.rationale: Kept because it is what a verification gate is for: filler-to-filler spacing constraints are inactive when hx = hy, so the square case could not have revealed them; closed forms are retained only where provably exact.
nodes.norm_label: negative result: closed form does not survive the move to rectangles

nodes.label: Scope condition: weak-tier, single-vendor regularity
nodes.rationale: Cuts against the loop-relevance framing: the discovery systems cited run frontier or mid-tier proposers, i.e. the tier at which the regularity does not hold.

nodes.label: Scope condition: unconditioned calls only (title scoped accordingly)
nodes.norm_label: scope condition: unconditioned calls only (title scoped accordingly)

nodes.label: Arithmetic-tractability alternative (mechanism-free)
nodes.rationale: A k x k grid at r = 1/(2k) is close to the only construction emittable from mental arithmetic without error accumulation; probed by arm CH and found wrong about selection, right about instantiation.

nodes.label: Non-claim guard (behavioral regularity, no mechanism claim)
nodes.rationale: Storage-and-retrieval vocabulary was corrected to emission vocabulary; the model emits, the distribution concentrates, the formula identifies the modal output.
nodes.norm_label: non-claim guard (behavioral regularity, no mechanism claim)

nodes.label: Scope condition: single-vendor evidence
nodes.rationale: All tiers in the main study come from one provider; two preregistered cross-vendor extensions (GM, GM2/GM3) are disclosed regardless of outcome, and GM2's 0/140 parse rate cannot yet be separated from budget truncation.

nodes.label: Mutation Without Variation (2606.05408, Gurkan, Stonedahl, Wilensky)
nodes.author: Gurkan, Stonedahl, Wilensky
nodes.norm_label: mutation without variation (2606.05408, gurkan, stonedahl, wilensky)

nodes.label: Zhang et al. (2407.10873) — importance of evolutionary search
nodes.author: Zhang et al.
nodes.norm_label: zhang et al. (2407.10873) — importance of evolutionary search

nodes.label: Served Precision Is Part of the Model (paper 2)
nodes.author: Soham Shailesh Gugale
nodes.norm_label: served precision is part of the model (paper 2)

nodes.label: Circle packing benchmark (N=26, unit square)
nodes.rationale: Chosen because candidates are scored by an exact deterministic local evaluator - no model, no judge, no rubric - so every source of run-to-run variance lives on the model side of the interface.

nodes.label: Heilbronn triangle task (n=13)
nodes.rationale: Chosen because a regular grid scores exactly zero on it, so a proposer emitting its default template is distinguishable from a proposer copying its parent - a separation circle packing cannot make, since its seeded parent WAS the template.

nodes.label: LABS discrete task (n=32)
nodes.rationale: Registered as a discrete task with no float arithmetic, to test the 'echo is float-rounding' reading of the cliff.

nodes.label: Seeded parent geometry (26 circles, 6x5 lattice, score 0.900)
nodes.rationale: Every lineage starts from the same seeded valid parent so every lineage has a floor; Q2_K lineages that never improve keep this grid as parent for all ten generations.
nodes.norm_label: seeded parent geometry (26 circles, 6x5 lattice, score 0.900)

nodes.label: Constructible template family (k x k grid, k*(N) = floor(sqrt(N)+1/2))
nodes.rationale: Predicted values are exact rationals/algebraic numbers, so a proposal either sits on an anchored construction to within rendering precision or it does not; detectable at 1e-6, three orders below the ~1e-2 gap between rival constructions.
nodes.norm_label: constructible template family (k x k grid, k*(n) = floor(sqrt(n)+1/2))

nodes.label: Registered primary tolerance 1e-6 (with strict 1e-9 logged)
nodes.rationale: Registered rather than argued because choosing between tolerances after seeing results would have been the easiest way to fabricate a result table; 1e-6 sits far below the ~1e-2 separation between rival constructions and so cannot manufacture a prediction hit.

nodes.label: Quantization ladder (llama.cpp K-quants, SHA-256 pinned)
nodes.rationale: Holds the inference stack fixed (same llama.cpp build, sampling parameters, harness, hardware within a run) and varies only the SHA-256-pinned weight file, so it measures served-weight precision rather than a decode-path effect.

nodes.label: Rung Q8_0 (8.5 effective bits/weight)
nodes.rationale: Registered as a ceiling rung on both dispersion-probe waves but never attempted: provenance.json records 'needs 2 gpus, have 1' - a recoverable hardware ceiling, not a failed run.

nodes.label: Rung Q4_K_M (4.85 effective bits/weight, reference rung)
nodes.norm_label: rung q4_k_m (4.85 effective bits/weight, reference rung)

nodes.label: Rung Q2_K (3.35 effective bits/weight, the cliff endpoint)
nodes.norm_label: rung q2_k (3.35 effective bits/weight, the cliff endpoint)

nodes.label: Effective bits co-vary with quantization algorithm
nodes.rationale: Because nominal bits/weight index the scheme rather than being independent of it, every ladder result is a Q2_K claim and not yet a bit-width claim - which is what the IQ2 control was registered to turn from caveat into measurement.
nodes.norm_label: effective bits co-vary with quantization algorithm

nodes.label: Precision cliff (C1): collapse in proposal variation, not viability
nodes.rationale: Degrading served quantization leaves viability and validity undetectably changed at n=50/rung while at the 2-bit rung the proposer very largely stops departing from its parent - a failure mode invisible to every pass/fail instrument.
nodes.norm_label: precision cliff (c1): collapse in proposal variation, not viability

nodes.label: Coordinate-verified parent echo
nodes.rationale: Defined as a valid output whose emitted circle set is identical, order-insensitive at six-decimal log precision, to its lineage's running parent; coordinates were logged precisely because the original score-inferred metric could not distinguish verbatim copies from same-sum rearrangements.

nodes.label: Registered echo bound: q2_k >= 60%, q4_k_m <= 35%
nodes.rationale: Released in the runner's header block (kaggle_precision_sweep_14b_fresh.py) and pushed before the run executed, so the registration is readable in the file that carried it rather than only as the authors' description.

nodes.label: Fresh-seed echo 79% (19/24) vs 6% (1/17)
nodes.rationale: Load-bearing figure: five never-sampled seeds (2222, 3333, 5555, 7777, 9999) make every registered prediction genuinely falsifiable, unlike the re-execution.

nodes.label: Re-execution echo 94% (17/18) vs 14% (8/57)
nodes.rationale: Reported second because it is a re-execution, not a replication: llama.cpp seeded sampling is deterministic on fixed weights and hardware, so only the coordinate-level predictions (absent from the console log) carried evidential weight.

nodes.label: Data loss and coordinate-verified re-execution
nodes.rationale: The original 14B run's output directory was destroyed by session expiry; the rung was re-executed against SHA-256-pinned weights with three logging-only additions, and the coordinate check refuted the score-inferred upper-rung estimates (4 of 12 presumed echoes reclassified as rearrangements).

nodes.label: Registered must-differ probe (5/5 echo at Q2_K vs 1/5 at Q4_K_M)
nodes.rationale: Both branches specified in advance (>=50% echo -> instruction-insensitive; <=20% -> instruction-sensitive); the model is not ignoring instructions wholesale, it is specifically unable to produce a differing valid packing, so the gating mechanism is architectural rather than promptable.
nodes.norm_label: registered must-differ probe (5/5 echo at q2_k vs 1/5 at q4_k_m)

nodes.label: Selection-effect loophole closed (invalid rows are copy-dominated)
nodes.rationale: A validity-filter explanation predicts mutation-dominated invalid rows; classifying every non-valid row shows there is no garbage and Q2_K's invalid rows are themselves majority near-copies (~70% copies/near-copies over the whole output distribution).
nodes.norm_label: selection-effect loophole closed (invalid rows are copy-dominated)

nodes.label: Accepted hill-climb step (1/50 at Q2_K vs 14-16 upper rungs)
nodes.rationale: Reported because it is the unit a loop's cost is denominated in; but accepted <= valid - echo holds by construction, so most of the contrast is the echo result seen in complement rather than an independent result.
nodes.norm_label: accepted hill-climb step (1/50 at q2_k vs 14-16 upper rungs)

nodes.label: Search-progress statistic (post-hoc, lineage-level)
nodes.rationale: Post-hoc and in no preregistration; reported as a consequence of the registered echo result. It is a finer form of the refuted F1 and explicitly does not inherit F1's registration.

nodes.label: Final best score is blind to the search collapse
nodes.rationale: Final best score is a maximum, so it is insensitive to draw count by construction; six lineage-level permutation tests across both scales give p = 0.12-0.94. A wave wanting to demonstrate harm should measure time-to-threshold, AUC of best-so-far, or accepted-step count instead.
nodes.norm_label: final best score is blind to the search collapse

nodes.label: Viability and validity metrics (flat across rungs)
nodes.rationale: Reported as non-rejection, not demonstrated equivalence: no equivalence test was run and n=50/rung is not powered for one (Wilson on 7/50 is [0.070, 0.262], compatible with a fourfold ratio).
nodes.norm_label: viability and validity metrics (flat across rungs)

nodes.label: Format lottery (7B viability reduces to count accuracy)
nodes.rationale: Quantization noise did not improve the model; it widened a count distribution that was biased just below an arbitrary acceptance point. Token truncation ruled out directly (max 687 tokens against a 1200 cap).
nodes.norm_label: format lottery (7b viability reduces to count accuracy)

nodes.label: 7B viability inversion (16/50 at Q2_K) - founding hypothesis refuted
nodes.rationale: At 7B the proposer sits below the floor at which precision could matter: no probe valid at any rung (0/30), best score 1.800 against the 2.5414 anchor.
nodes.norm_label: 7b viability inversion (16/50 at q2_k) - founding hypothesis refuted

nodes.label: Instrument invisibility argument
nodes.rationale: The failed proposals are coherent, well-formed near-copies, which is why every pass/fail instrument reports health; the same argument recurs one level up when final best score cannot see the search collapse.

nodes.label: Fixed-parent dispersion probe (wave 1, 288 rows)
nodes.rationale: Run against the authors' own result to remove the parent-quality confound: it bounds the cliff rather than extending it, and 18 harness-failure rows (logprobs ValueError) are excluded from model-behaviour denominators.

nodes.label: Dispersion probe wave 2 (432 rows, salted seeds)
nodes.rationale: Carries its own preregistration and addendum; its registered primary (rarefied distinct solutions 38.31/46.78/13.00 at m=84, JT p=0.0081) had been omitted from earlier drafts alongside the FAILED label - omissions cutting in opposite directions.
nodes.norm_label: dispersion probe wave 2 (432 rows, salted seeds)

nodes.label: Parent-quality confound in loop echo rates
nodes.rationale: Q2_K lineages rarely improve so their running parent stays the seeded grid while upper rungs climb away from it; the confound runs in the direction that flatters the headline result.
nodes.norm_label: parent-quality confound in loop echo rates

nodes.label: Matched fixed-parent contrast 33% (6/18) vs 92% (11/12)
nodes.rationale: Restricted to the 0.88-0.90 parent band the loop actually occupies: direction and 2-bit endpoint survive, spread does not, and the registered upper-rung <=35% bound would have FAILED under fixed parents at 52-61%.

nodes.label: Single-lattice design limitation of the probe
nodes.rationale: All six 'parents' share identical circle centres and differ only in radii, so the probe can speak to radius variation and cannot observe a proposer moving to a different construction; the 92-98% centre-echo result is a statement about the only lattice ever shown.
nodes.norm_label: single-lattice design limitation of the probe

nodes.label: Post-hoc decomposition (centres copied / radii varied)
nodes.rationale: Constructed after the registered centre measures came back flat; its middle column is identically the legacy echo count, so all it adds is a partition of the non-echo rows - three rows split 2 and 1 at Q2_K on wave 1.

nodes.label: IQ2 scheme-vs-bit-width control (inconclusive branch)
nodes.rationale: Imatrix Q2_K echoes at 75% against IQ2_M's 43%, so the cliff is not an artifact of one weight file; but 43% falls between the registered thresholds, and the fixed-parent control later withdraws the scheme-gradient reading because Q4_K_M's matched rate is 33-52%, not 6%.

nodes.label: Conditional-quality exclusion (8/10 departures improve at Q2_K)
nodes.rationale: The single post-hoc exclusion the paper claims, and its thinnest load-bearing item: rules out a collapse in departure quality at 95% on ten departures, by 0.8 points against the least favourable comparator, reversing if one row flips; scored against an unlocked design note whose 25-departure power floor is unmet.
nodes.norm_label: conditional-quality exclusion (8/10 departures improve at q2_k)

nodes.label: Frequency-of-departure vs quality-of-departure distinction
nodes.rationale: A frequency-only effect is in principle repairable by forcing departure; a quality effect is not. The must-differ probe shows instruction does not recover the occasion, making the worthwhile intervention architectural (decoding constraints, temperature, diversity penalties) rather than a prompt.

nodes.label: Horizon power projection (withdrawn)
nodes.rationale: Withdrawn because the only alternative the resampling model supplies is its own projection, which puts Q2_K ahead at every horizon - six observed 2-bit departure offers cannot carry a direction and therefore cannot carry an effect size a power number is defined against.

nodes.label: F1 improvement-count prediction (designated primary, REFUTED)
nodes.rationale: Runner header labels F1 'Improvement (seed-level, primary)'; forecast <=2/5 Q2_K seeds improving, 3/5 did (Fisher p=0.44 against 5/5). Reported because the surviving endpoint F2 carries no primary label.

nodes.label: External determinism check: 112/112 per-row digest MATCH
nodes.rationale: Public Kaggle kernel sohamgugalet/precision-redetermin re-ran the Q4_K_M and Q2_K rungs bracketing the cliff on the original T4 hardware class; two earlier P100 draws correctly returned VOID_ARCH rather than comparing across architectures, since cross-hardware nondeterminism is a known finding not a defect to explain away. Wheel version-pinned (0.3.34), original build unrecoverable.
nodes.norm_label: external determinism check: 112/112 per-row digest match

nodes.label: Wave 3: Heilbronn transfer (495 calls)
nodes.rationale: First externally-timestamped registration in either paper (public Kaggle kernel pushed before sampling). Echo bound held at Q2_K (63.1% vs >=55%) but refuted at Q4_K_M (46.9% vs <=30%): echo is driven jointly by precision and by whether the search has anywhere to go.

nodes.label: Wave 4: hosted capability-tier control (0/120 echoes)
nodes.rationale: Registered to test the strongest alternative reading - that echo is what any sufficiently weak proposer does. Stuck hosted tiers emit zero-scoring collinear templates (97.5% at the strongest tier); stuck 2-bit rungs copy the parent. Weakness alone does not produce the failure mode.

nodes.label: Wave 5: LABS discrete-task transfer (UNINFORMATIVE)
nodes.rationale: Control floor fired (Q4_K_M accepted zero steps); its unclaimable descriptives reverse the rung ordering (4.3% Q2_K vs 20.0% Q4_K_M), and the registration predicted its own failure mode before running.

nodes.label: Wave 7: family generality, Llama + Gemma (UNDERPOWERED)
nodes.rationale: Registered per-family directional contrasts only, no absolute band imported, with a 20-valid-row power floor precisely so that this outcome reads as 'could not test' rather than 'no difference'. Descriptive: all 18 Gemma valid outputs are coordinate-exact parent echoes; none of Llama's 6 are.

nodes.label: Wave 7b: competence-matched retry, Phi-4 + Mistral-24B (UNDERPOWERED)
nodes.rationale: Fired the registered both-underpowered branch: the task's format-competence floor excluded every non-Qwen family tested up to 24B. Descriptively the arms did climb and neither echoed once, so parent-copying looks family-shaped rather than bit-width-shaped on these small samples.

nodes.label: Control-arm floor clause
nodes.rationale: Written to force UNINFORMATIVE when the reference rung cannot climb, because a rung that cannot climb cannot separate 'the rungs do not differ' from 'the task is too hard'.

nodes.label: Verdict FAILED (dispersion probe wave 2, addendum R2)
nodes.rationale: Addendum rule R2 requires a ceiling rung to land; q8_0 did not, so no trend test is reportable and every v2 descriptive is exploratory. The released analyser prints the label unprompted.
nodes.norm_label: verdict failed (dispersion probe wave 2, addendum r2)

nodes.label: Verdict unclassified (dispersion probe wave 1)
nodes.rationale: SURVIVES, PARTIAL and FALSIFIED each require a combination the outcomes do not supply and UNDERPOWERED does not apply; this disqualifies the registered mechanism verdict specifically, not the probe's descriptive counts.

nodes.label: Four non-poolable p-value families (29 tails, no claim rests on any)
nodes.rationale: Nine Fisher (candidate-level ones nest rows within lineages and overstate evidence), six registered permutation tests belonging to rules that returned unusable verdicts, two Spearman orthogonality diagnostics, twelve post-hoc lineage permutations that are seed-crossed but unstratified and two of which sit on the arithmetic floor of their enumeration (2/252).
nodes.norm_label: four non-poolable p-value families (29 tails, no claim rests on any)

nodes.label: opus_alias arm (C2 forensic case study, 30 invocations)
nodes.rationale: Labelled by alias and never given a version number, because the runtime accepts an alias only and nothing in its response surface reports which weights served a call - the request for a specific dated model was undetectably unsatisfiable.
nodes.norm_label: opus_alias arm (c2 forensic case study, 30 invocations)

nodes.label: Serving signature: 2.8-9 s vs 75-250 s and 150-1170 s
nodes.rationale: Stated as a working-log evidence class rather than in a limitations section: the per-invocation duration vector was never captured into the released artifact, so a reader can recompute every validity figure and check no latency figure - itself an instance of what §6 item 4 argues for.
nodes.norm_label: serving signature: 2.8-9 s vs 75-250 s and 150-1170 s

nodes.label: Behavioral signature: validity 4/30 vs 30/30, 50/60, 63/70
nodes.rationale: Tolerance-invariant (4/30 at both 1e-6 and 1e-9); failures are geometric, not formatting - all 26 invalid rows overlap - and the arm attempted a MORE ambitious construction family, so the registered regression-toward-trap disconfirmation condition did not occur.

nodes.label: H1: serving-path degradation
nodes.rationale: A fast decode path erodes arithmetic precision needed to close a tangency while leaving construction choice intact - precisely the quantization cliff's signature, surface competence preserved and constructive competence removed.

nodes.label: H2: genuine tier property
nodes.rationale: To cover the observable set H2 must be conjoined with an auxiliary - 'a fast serving path was in use but had no behavioral effect' - which is H1's mechanism minus its causal claim and therefore strictly more complex; the observations mildly favour H1 within the snapshot without deciding.

nodes.label: Observable set O (completion text, duration, aggregate usage, error codes)
nodes.rationale: On the text channel both hypotheses induce the same distribution; on timing they are asymmetric. No element of O reports which decode path served a call, which is the irreducible residue.
nodes.norm_label: observable set o (completion text, duration, aggregate usage, error codes)

nodes.label: C3: non-identifiability of the serving path (runtime-conditioned)
nodes.rationale: Stated conditionally on one vendor and one runtime; a runtime exposing a serving-path flag or weights digest would falsify it for that runtime. It is a claim about attesting a PAST call, not about the practical question being closed - fingerprinting methods detect change between snapshots but attest no past decode path.
nodes.norm_label: c3: non-identifiability of the serving path (runtime-conditioned)

nodes.label: Arm B2 dated re-snapshot (30/30 vs 4/30, P-R0 disconfirmed)
nodes.rationale: Registered as the anchor because a repair score without one is uninterpretable: a clean result would be equally consistent with 'repair is easy for the path that served 4/30' and with 'the alias resolves to something else this week'.
nodes.norm_label: arm b2 dated re-snapshot (30/30 vs 4/30, p-r0 disconfirmed)

nodes.label: Arm R repair probe (59/60 exact, flat in delta)
nodes.rationale: Ran because it was registered, and may not be read: P-R0's failure triggers the registration's fourth branch. Reporting the number and refusing the inference is C3 applied to a result the authors would have liked.
nodes.norm_label: arm r repair probe (59/60 exact, flat in delta)

nodes.label: Alias drift within six days renders H1/H2 unaskable
nodes.rationale: H1 and H2 remain well-formed about the 2026-08-01 call; what is gone is any route to testing them, because the alias no longer addresses the thing they are about and a later call is a sample of an unknown condition rather than a second sample of the same one.
nodes.norm_label: alias drift within six days renders h1/h2 unaskable

nodes.label: Uniform ~49.9k usage observation (withdrawn twice)
nodes.rationale: An undisaggregated aggregate counter over a large fixed prefix is not a serving signature; arm R's same-day same-alias rows are uniform to 1.01-fold, so the spread tracks the task not the date, and usage correlates with duration at r=+0.69.

nodes.label: Alias opacity: weights behind an alias are a promise, not a hash
nodes.rationale: Which quantization is served is one of several things an alias leaves unattested - and it is now a variable the dependent measure is known to be sensitive to.
nodes.norm_label: alias opacity: weights behind an alias are a promise, not a hash

nodes.label: C4: repair protocol (prompt hashing, verbatim raw, alias maps, deterministic scoring, hash-locked prereg)
nodes.rationale: Audited against itself: three of five repairs are fully implemented, and the two that are not are named - the alias map covers only the Haiku proposer and RUN_DATE is not the opus_alias arm's date, so the headline provenance repair is unimplemented for precisely the arm the paper is about.
nodes.norm_label: c4: repair protocol (prompt hashing, verbatim raw, alias maps, deterministic scoring, hash-locked prereg)

nodes.label: Missing batch key / colliding sample_id defect
nodes.rationale: arm_f_raw.json was overwritten in place by a later wave reusing arm labels with colliding sample_ids and no run-date field, so a reported 45-row slice cannot be reconstructed - verbatim storage without a row key is weaker than claimed.
nodes.norm_label: missing batch key / colliding sample_id defect

nodes.label: §6 item 4 duration-CV canary (firing condition withdrawn)
nodes.rationale: Audited against §3's own rows on a stack where the serving path is fixed by construction, and it fired anyway (CV ratio 0.237 and 0.289, permutation p<0.0001). Proposing a threshold shown to fire on a fixed serving path, whose obvious repair fails three ways, would be worse than proposing none; the disclosure half is retained.

nodes.label: Output-degeneracy confound (a degenerate proposer mimics a fast path)
nodes.rationale: Duration CV is low among echo rows at every rung; Q2_K's aggregate CV is low because 46 of 49 valid rows are echoes - a property of the output, not the path that served it. The two call for opposite responses.
nodes.norm_label: output-degeneracy confound (a degenerate proposer mimics a fast path)

nodes.label: Cold-start warm-up gradient (~92% of steady-state throughput)
nodes.rationale: Uniform across all twelve rung x wave cells; on wave 2 every cold row happened to be an echo or invalid, so the echo filter removed them by accident and the 'non-echo' set is silently a warm set. A verifier's fresh probe is always a cold invocation.
nodes.norm_label: cold-start warm-up gradient (~92% of steady-state throughput)

nodes.label: Same-SHA throughput ordering inverts across hardware (P100 vs 2xT4)
nodes.rationale: Structural rather than sample-limited, and the one that matters most: attestation is precisely the case where the verifier does not control the hardware the calibration would need. Also shows throughput does not order by bit-width, so speed and precision are separate axes even on a fixed stack.
nodes.norm_label: same-sha throughput ordering inverts across hardware (p100 vs 2xt4)

nodes.label: §6 item 5: parent-echo canary screen (echo_screen.py)
nodes.rationale: The only instrument the paper still proposes. Published with its precondition - the held parent must be WEAK - because against a good parent a healthy Q4_K_M echoes at 62-74%, past the red line; the tool cannot detect the violation, and a screen whose false-positive condition is undocumented is worse than no screen. A tripwire, not a calibrated precision detector.

nodes.label: What vendors could expose (weights digest, sampling echo, serving-path flag)
nodes.rationale: Each is a single field in a response object; a serving-path boolean would have separated §4's two hypotheses outright.
nodes.norm_label: what vendors could expose (weights digest, sampling echo, serving-path flag)

nodes.label: Model-written scorer circularity, answered by reimplementation
nodes.rationale: sec3_ladder_repro.py was written from the definitions in the text rather than from the original implementation; agreement is exact except one invalid-row near-copy count (2/22 vs 1/22). Not independence in the strong sense, but it establishes the figures follow from the released rows rather than from a scorer's quirks.
nodes.norm_label: model-written scorer circularity, answered by reimplementation

nodes.label: Scope condition: family generality unresolved
nodes.rationale: Every non-Qwen family tested, up to 24B, sat below the task's format-competence floor, so the cliff's family scope is stated as an open limitation rather than estimated. Needs a coder-tuned non-Qwen 14B or a format-forgiving task.

nodes.label: Scope condition: one vendor, one agent runtime
nodes.norm_label: scope condition: one vendor, one agent runtime

nodes.label: Scope condition: served-weight precision only, not the whole serving stack
nodes.rationale: That degrading one serving-stack element collapses proposal variation does not establish that other elements do; the generalization is the hypothesis the paper raises, not a result it establishes.
nodes.norm_label: scope condition: served-weight precision only, not the whole serving stack

nodes.label: Scope condition: N=26 sweep vs §4's N=13/21/31 cells
nodes.rationale: Two gaps, both real: the mechanism gap is supported by §3's measurement rather than measured inside the runtime, and the instance gap is an inference from the companion paper's template-family finding, not a replication.
nodes.norm_label: scope condition: n=26 sweep vs §4's n=13/21/31 cells

nodes.label: Rival reading: recall/contamination rather than construction (unscreened)
nodes.rationale: The cells the anchoring argument leans on all correspond to closed-form grid recipes - exactly the population most likely to appear in a training corpus - so the design gives the rival reading its best case. The written screen has three named defects and is not run.
nodes.norm_label: rival reading: recall/contamination rather than construction (unscreened)

hyperedges.label: Three attractor families form the tier ladder with its validity inversion
Closed-form prediction pipeline: order rule to branch rule to LP-verified point prediction at the mode ceiling
Preregistered extensions M/MU/CH each narrowed the claim's scope via a triggered falsifier or decomposition
Registered echo bound: registration -> fresh seeds -> must-differ -> scheme control
Blindness cascade: viability/validity, then echo, then accepted steps, then final best score
Self-audit withdrawals: canary fires on fixed path, repair fails three ways
